aboutTitle: Building the Tech Future at UKF
aboutText1: Nitra Technological Incubator (NTI) is an innovation platform operating at the Constantine the Philosopher University in Nitra. Our goal is to transform academic ideas and student talent into real, competitive technology solutions.
aboutText2: We bridge the worlds of education, research, and business. We provide facilities, expert mentoring from industry leaders, and access to partnerships with top IT companies in Slovakia.
aboutVal1Desc: We support bold technological concepts with global market potential.
aboutVal2Desc: We connect talented students directly with companies and active investors.
aboutVal3Desc: Experienced professionals guide teams step-by-step from raw idea to working MVP.
